trust_decision.summary: Whether a new instance's config/devices satisfy the target project's restrictions is decided by project.AllowInstanceCreation, called in instancesPost on the request body before createFromCopy merges the source instance's local config and devices into that request; the merged result is never re-checked.

landing_point.why: The summary names cross-project instance copy and a config merge; createFromCopy is the copy handler and does the merge at lines 454-488.

fix_sites.module_kind: HTTP handler (inferred site: fix.diff has no hunks, see unverified)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: lxd/instance_post.go:416-563 (instancePostMigration: the same LocalConfig/LocalDevices merge into a new project followed by instanceCreateAsCopy, with no AllowInstanceCreation call)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report says 'copy'; moving an instance (POST /1.0/instances/{name} with project) is a separate 'move' feature in another file, so a solver can argue it is a neighbouring feature that is out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A cross-project copy whose source config is allowed in the target must still work, and an explicit req.Config key must still override the source value (so a user can copy a privileged source into a restricted project by setting security.privileged=false). Volatile keys must still be stripped or filtered on copy rather than rejected. A fix that rejects all cross-project copies, drops the source config, or checks the source config before the override breaks this.

O6_input_shapes: source instance config keys (e.g. security.privileged, raw.*) merged in when they are absent from req.Config
source local devices merged in when they are absent from req.Devices
request-supplied overrides that take precedence over the source

O7_producer.where: lxd/instances_post.go:454-488 (source LocalConfig/LocalDevices merged into req); snapshot args are built at lxd/instance.go:339-352 and lxd/instance/instance_utils.go:1202-1213

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Moving an instance to another project via instancePostMigration copies its local config and devices into the target project, and no project-restriction check is run on them.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Move is a different operation from copy, lives in another file, and only checks manage-containers on the target project.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: On copy, the source's snapshots are recreated in the target project with their own LocalConfig and LocalDevices, and no restriction check is run on them (backup import does check snapshots).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Snapshots are not runnable, and restore re-checks them at lxd/instance_put.go:241-249, so creating them can be argued harmless.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A copy with source.refresh onto an existing target syncs source snapshots and skips the target's config entirely, so snapshots arrive without any restriction check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Refresh is an incremental-sync feature, and the target instance already passed its checks.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A clustered copy from a non-ceph source on another member is redirected to the migration path, and the sink creates snapshots from the migration header with no restriction check.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: This is the cluster migration transport, a legacy-looking path in the drivers package far from the copy handler.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The move-to-project merge of LocalConfig/LocalDevices, with no AllowInstanceCreation call on the merged args.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It already exists in the real code. It mirrors createFromCopy and was written for pool moves, where the project does not change.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Drop the per-snapshot check in backup import, so imported snapshot configs bypass restrictions.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer could treat snapshots as inert records, as instanceCreateAsCopy already does.
